assets.md_placeholder: [FIGURE: PNF0302-V02-VENT — Engineering detail drawing showing hydrostatic test vent assemblies for socketweld piping, NPS 3/4 through 1-1/2. Three configurations are illustrated: (left) NPS 3/4 threaded plug with NPS 3/4 thredolet on NPS 1-1/2 line size, showing NPS 3/4 x 100(4) nipple (plain one end x thread one end) and NPS 3/4 threaded cap; (center) NPS 3/4 & NPS 1 line size using NPS 3/4 TEE or NPS 1 x NPS 3/4 reducing tee; (right) NPS 3/4 line size using NPS 3/4 TEE, with NPS 3/4 x 100(4) nipple (plain one end x thread one end) and NPS 3/4 threaded cap on each branch.]
